title.zh: SmartLingo 公开音频 Help 会议室

purpose.zh: 已登录会员从账户菜单直接进入站点帮助室，与主持团队私聊；主持团队可按需启动音频，会议卡片保持普通样式且不显示介绍。
purpose.en: Let signed-in members open the site Help room from the account menu for private host-team chat and optional host audio, with an ordinary undescribed room card.

zh: 账户菜单在退出登录前显示本地化 Help 入口，直达公开免费音频 Webinar。
Help 会议室复用现有私密支持聊天、录音、附件、在线成员及按需连接 RealtimeKit 的课堂功能。
Help 会议室没有介绍文字或专属卡片样式，只有已验证管理员可主持。
en: Add a localized Help entry immediately before Sign out, leading to a public free audio Webinar.
Reuse the existing private support chat, audio notes, attachments, member presence, and demand-driven RealtimeKit lifecycle.
Keep the Help card ordinary and without description, hosted by a verified administrator.

zh: 登录账户菜单、Help 路由、Help 会议室资料及会议详情页。
en: Signed-in account menu, Help route, Help room record, and room detail page.

zh: D1 迁移创建单例 Help 会议室；如管理员在迁移后建立，则入口可安全补建。Help 媒体类型及公开权限固定，防止误改或误删。
en: A D1 migration seeds the singleton Help room; its entry can safely provision it when the admin arrives after migration. Lock the public audio settings against accidental edits or deletion.

zh: 全量 TypeScript、零警告 lint、Vinext 构建与敏感数据扫描、D1 全量迁移重放及 Help 音频 Webinar 数据校验、全量单元测试。
en: Full TypeScript, zero-warning lint, Vinext build and sensitive-data scan, complete D1 replay and Help audio Webinar assertions, and the full unit suite.

zh: 不自动开始媒体连接；多用户实时收听验收沿用课堂独立 QA 流程。
en: No automatic media connection; multi-user live listening remains part of the independent classroom QA flow.

zh: 使用 SmartLingo 自有 D1、Clerk、RealtimeKit 与十二语言菜单，不导入其他站点运行时代码。
en: Use SmartLingo-owned D1, Clerk, and RealtimeKit resources and a twelve-language menu without cross-site runtime imports.

rollback.zh: 可回退应用代码；迁移是新增表与会议室记录。若需删除数据，先确认无会员聊天、录音或附件并单独审查。
rollback.en: Application code can be rolled back; the migration adds a table and room record. Review member chat, recordings, and attachments before any separate data removal.
